Ram Temple Donation Probe Sparks Political Debate and Investigations

An investigation into alleged embezzlement of donations at Ayodhya's Ram Temple is underway, leading to political accusations and legal proceedings. While some outlets focus on the probe and its potential impact on the BJP, others highlight related events like a Congress delegation's visit to the temple and statements from political figures. The situation has drawn attention to the temple's financial dealings and the political ramifications of the allegations.
